You’ll help improve the advisor experience through intelligent tooling, define how customers reach support across channels, and strengthen the API layer underpinning our service ecosystem. Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.
What You'll Do
Own the product vision and roadmap for the tools our support advisors use every day, improving efficiency and enabling better outcomes for users.
 Define and evolve how customers access support across chat, email, social messaging, and emerging channels, helping the right contact reach the right advisor at the right time.
 Strengthen the foundational API layer connecting our support systems, with a focus on reliability, extensibility, and developer experience as the platform scales.
 Take initiatives from discovery through launch, partnering closely with engineering to ship iteratively, learn quickly, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
 Identify opportunities to thoughtfully apply AI and automation within advisor workflows and channel routing to improve speed, accuracy, and the advisor experience.
 Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, and customer service operations to build scalable capabilities that serve both advisors and users.
 Define meaningful success metrics, run experiments, and use data and customer insights to make clear prioritisation decisions and measure impact.
Who You Are
You have 4+ years of product management experience and a track record of delivering impactful products in technology-driven environments.
 You think in systems and understand how APIs, integrations, platforms, and tooling can work together to create leverage across an organisation.
 You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on API design, system architecture, and technical trade-offs; you don't need to write code, but you can engage confidently in technical conversations.
 You know how to take products from discovery through delivery, balancing thoughtful product development with the pace needed to learn and make progress.
 You are curious about customer service and support operations and bring empathy for both the people providing support and the users receiving it.
 You communicate clearly, can make complex trade-offs understandable, and know how to create alignment across technical and non-technical partners.
 You use data, experimentation, customer insight, and judgement to make decisions and are comfortable adapting when you learn something new.
 You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines and care about building products that create meaningful outcomes for customers and the people who support them.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London, UK.
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

title: Product Manager - Data Platform
content:
Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.
Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.
Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.
We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.
What You'll Do
Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify's data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage domain.
 Diagnose and deeply understand the needs of Spotify's data community, including data engineers, data scientists, analysts, ML engineers, and increasingly AI agents.
 Identify and prioritize the highest-impact problems to solve, balancing user needs, business priorities, platform requirements, and regulatory considerations.
 Evaluate and deliver solutions through building, buying, or integrating third-party products and capabilities.
 Define success metrics and KPIs that measure adoption, value creation, and business impact.
 Build strong relationships with internal product, engineering, analytics, and data teams to understand workflows, gather feedback, and shape future platform investments.
 Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and data science partners to deliver high-quality platform experiences.
 Influence stakeholders across the Data Platform Studio and broader Spotify organization to align around product direction and priorities.
 Help shape how Spotify approaches metadata, governance, discoverability, lineage, and trust in an increasingly AI-driven world.
 Stay informed on industry trends across data platforms, developer tools, AI/ML infrastructure, analytics, and data governance.
Who You Are
You have 2+ years of Product Management experience, ideally working on platform products, developer tools, data infrastructure, analytics platforms, or data governance systems.
 You have a technical foundation through a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, and/or prior experience in engineering or technical roles.
 You are comfortable working with engineers and can engage in technical discussions while representing customer and business needs.
 You are an excellent communicator and collaborator who can build alignment across teams with different priorities and levels of technical expertise.
 You have strong systems-thinking skills and can connect workflows, platforms, users, and business outcomes.
 You have empathy for people who work with data and understand the challenges they face every day.
 You enjoy working through ambiguity, breaking down complex problems, and creating clarity for teams.
 You are curious about how AI is transforming the data landscape and are excited to help shape that future.
 You lead with humility, build trust through collaboration, and help teams move forward with focus and momentum.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London or Stockholm
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
content:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/
What You'll Do
Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas: 
 Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing. 
 Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence. 
 Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes. 
 You will also: 
 Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
 Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
 Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
 Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
 Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.
Who You Are
You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
 You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
 You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
 You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
 You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
 You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
 You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
 You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
Where You'll Be
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location. 
 This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.
 Core working hours are CET 3pm-6pm / EST 9am-12pm.
The United States base range for this position is $133,194 - $190,278 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, a monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays. These ranges may be modified in the future.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

title: Research Scientist - Personalization
content:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.Spotify’s
Personalization organization builds the technology that helps millions of listeners discover what they love. Within this space, our research team focuses on advancing the state of the art in machine learning and AI to shape the future of personalization. We explore new approaches, challenge existing assumptions, and contribute to the broader research community while influencing long-term product direction.
What You'll Do
Conduct original research in machine learning and AI, with a focus on large-scale foundation models, generative AI, and post-training methods, including reinforcement learning.
 Develop novel methodologies, models, and evaluation frameworks to advance personalization systems.
 Design and execute rigorous experiments to explore new ideas and validate research hypotheses.
 Contribute to the scientific community through publications, talks, and conference participation.

 You have demonstrated expertise in machine learning and artificial intelligence through peer-reviewed publications at conferences such as NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, KDD, or RecSys.
 You have deep knowledge of machine learning, with hands-on experience in areas such as post-training and reinforcement learning for large models, reward design, large-scale distributed training, or evaluation of model behavior.

title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
content:
At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success.
Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.
What You'll Do
Lead Spotify India's consumer retention and engagement marketing strategy across the listener lifecycle, from new and active users to dormant and lapsed listeners.
 Identify the key drivers of disengagement and churn, and develop targeted strategies that encourage repeat listening and long-term retention.
 Build tailored retention and re-engagement strategies for different listener segments, using behavioural insights, preferences and engagement patterns.
 Create personalised listener journeys that connect audiences with relevant music, artists, content and Spotify features.
 Partner with Data Science, Analytics and Consumer Insights teams to uncover engagement opportunities and turn consumer insights into actionable marketing initiatives.
 Define and track key performance indicators, including retention, churn, reactivation, daily and monthly active users, and engagement. Use experimentation to measure incremental impact and continuously improve results.
 Collaborate with Product, Music, Brand, Media and Consumer Marketing teams to develop a connected retention roadmap that brings together product experiences, music releases, artists and cultural moments.
 Translate insights and performance trends into clear recommendations that influence marketing priorities and drive measurable business outcomes.
Who You Are
You have 8+ years of experience in growth, lifecycle, retention or customer relationship management (CRM) marketing, with a track record of driving consumer engagement and retention.
 You understand consumer behaviour and know how to turn insights into strategies that encourage repeat usage and build long-term relationships.
 You have experience developing segmentation strategies, personalised consumer journeys and engagement programmes for large consumer audiences.
 You are confident working with data, analytics and experimentation to identify opportunities, evaluate performance and make informed decisions.
 You think beyond individual campaigns and channels, focusing on how marketing can influence consumer behaviour and deliver measurable business impact.
 You can bring teams together around shared goals and collaborate effectively with Product, Analytics, Data Science and Marketing partners.
 You are comfortable balancing long-term strategy with hands-on execution, adapting your approach as you learn what works.
 You are curious about music, culture and how digital experiences can create meaningful connections with listeners.

title: Revenue Operations Manager - Spotify Technology
content:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth.
You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.
What You'll Do
• Own sales operations for Spotify Technology, including CRM, pipeline management, forecasting, territory and account assignment, and deal desk processes.
 • Design and roll out a segmented sales model that evolves our go-to-market approach as the business matures.
 • Build infrastructure and systems to support a scalable Commercial sales motion (companies with fewer than 1,000 employees), focused on faster deal cycles, efficient lead routing, and repeatable processes.
 • Build infrastructure and systems to support a strategic Enterprise sales motion (companies with 1,000+ employees), enabling prospecting, account planning, and multi-product engagements.
 • Partner with the Director of Sales as a strategic advisor on quota setting, capacity planning, compensation, territory design, and headcount modeling.
 • Support revenue across the full customer lifecycle, including new business, expansion, and retention.
 • Build reporting and dashboards to track pipeline coverage, conversion rates, time to close, forecast accuracy, and net revenue retention by segment.
 • Strengthen forecasting discipline and maintain a healthy, predictable pipeline through effective reporting and sales processes.
 • Identify friction across the sales process, including handoffs between Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success, and drive improvements with cross-functional partners.
 • Partner with Marketing on pipeline generation reporting, lead management, and process improvements.
 • Establish and continuously improve operating rhythms, including forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs), as the business scales.
 • Evaluate and manage the go-to-market (GTM) technology stack to support efficient and scalable sales operations.
Who You Are
• You have 6+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or go-to-market strategy, with a track record of meaningful impact at a senior level.
 • You have experience scaling sales operations through a startup or high-growth phase and understand when to introduce new processes and structure.
 • You can build systems and processes from the ground up without adding unnecessary complexity.
 • You are proficient in using AI and can lead initiatives that improve sales effectiveness through AI-enabled tools and processes.
 • You have experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within developer platforms, DevOps tools, or cloud services.
 • You understand the differences between product-led growth (PLG), Commercial, and Enterprise sales motions and have experience designing segmented sales models.
 • You understand complex technical sales involving Sales Engineering and recognize the importance of customer retention and post-sale success in revenue strategy.
 • You have hands-on experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM, including building reports, workflows, and resolving data issues.
 • You use data to guide forecasting, capacity modeling, and funnel analysis, combining analytical skills with sound business judgment.
 • You can influence senior sales leaders, build alignment across teams, and drive decisions without formal authority.
 • You are comfortable working in evolving environments, adapting as priorities change, and helping shape how an innovative business grows.
Where You'll Be
• This role is based in London
 • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

title: Sales Manager, Enterprise — Spotify Technology
content:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As Sales Manager for our Enterprise team, you will lead the Account Executives who drive new business for Spotify Technology. Reporting to the Director of Sales, you'll set the strategy for how we win with organizations of 1,000+ employees, where buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and fewer, larger deals can take many months to close.
This is both a strategic and hands-on role: you'll shape our enterprise sales approach while staying close to the deals, coaching your team through complex opportunities and helping them close. You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to develop sellers, run a disciplined sales process, and engage confidently with senior engineering leaders will be key to your success.
What You'll Do
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enterprise Account Executives, helping each seller grow their skills and consistently achieve or exceed their targets.
 • Own quarterly and annual team revenue targets for new business with organizations of 1,000+ employees, in partnership with the Director of Sales.
 • Translate Spotify Technology's overall sales strategy into a clear enterprise plan, including target accounts, territory priorities, and account planning standards.
 • Build a team that converts inbound demand while proactively hunting new opportunities in target accounts.
 • Stay hands-on in key deals, joining customer meetings, supporting negotiations, and helping navigate complex buying committees.
 • Coach the team on strategic account planning, multi-threading, champion building, and developing executive-level business cases.
 • Run a disciplined operating rhythm through regular pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and one-on-ones, while maintaining accurate forecasts and a healthy, predictable pipeline for long-cycle deals.
 • Partner with Revenue Operations on territory design, reporting, and process improvements for the Enterprise segment.
 • Collaborate with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and proofs of concept, with Customer Success on retention and expansion, and with Marketing on account-based programs and pipeline generation.
 • Help sellers articulate how Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.
 • Help sellers tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.
 • Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.
 • Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and developing sales playbooks as the Enterprise team grows.
Who You Are
• You have 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, including closing large, complex enterprise deals, and 3+ years of experience managing sales teams.
 • You have a proven track record of building and developing high-performing teams that consistently achieve or exceed targets in enterprise environments.
 • You are both strategic and hands-on, comfortable setting direction while staying involved in the details of individual deals.
 • You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information and can coach your team to prioritize high-potential opportunities while confidently moving away from poorly qualified deals.
 • You have experience selling to engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams, or developer experience buyers, and understand how they evaluate and make purchasing decisions.
 • You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.
 • You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including procurement processes, security reviews, and multi-year agreements.
 • You have experience partnering closely with Sales Engineering and understand the importance of technical depth in complex enterprise sales.
 • You use data and metrics to guide forecasting, coaching, and decision-making, while building structure and processes without adding unnecessary complexity.
 • You bring strong communication, coaching, negotiation, and presentation skills.
 • You are excited to help build a scalable enterprise sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in New York City
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
The United States base range for this position is $143,510 - $205,015 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays. These ranges may be modified in the future.

title: Security Engineer - Detection and Response
content:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Security engineers at Spotify protect our platform, employees, creators, and more than 700 million users. We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer to join the Detection and Response organization and help identify, investigate, and respond to threats across Spotify's environment.
You will work within our detection engineering squad where the team owns alert triage, security investigations, threat hunting, and the detection engineering lifecycle. You will turn threat intelligence, incident learnings, and analyst feedback into effective detections and investigation workflows. You will partner closely with the detection infrastructure squad, which builds and operates Detection and Response platforms and telemetry pipelines, and with teams across Spotify to make sure your squad has the signals and capabilities needed to detect and respond to threats at Spotify's scale.
We are a distributed team that values curiosity, sound judgment, clear communication, and continuous learning. We teach and learn from one another, adapt as the threat landscape changes, and focus our effort according to business needs and risk.
What You'll Do
Identify detection opportunities, define clear telemetry requirements, and partner with the detection infrastructure squad and data owners to make the signals needed for detection and investigation available. 
 Develop, test, tune, and maintain detections across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, email, and other security-relevant environments. 
 Investigate and prioritize alerts, determine their security impact, and participate in incident containment and remediation. 
 Build repeatable investigation workflows and playbooks for alert triage, evidence collection, decision-making, escalation, containment, and response. 
 Improve proactive threat-identification and threat-hunting capabilities using internal telemetry and external threat intelligence. 
 Create cutting-edge AI workflows for Detection and Response that enrich alerts, gather and analyze evidence, guide investigations, and automate repetitive response work while preserving appropriate human judgment and oversight. 
 Measure detection effectiveness, identify coverage gaps, and tune detections to balance security value, fidelity, and analyst workload. 
 Use SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and related security platforms to research threats, develop detections, investigate alerts, and validate security outcomes. 
 Share knowledge, document decisions, and communicate security findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Who You Are
You are curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment. 
 You have 3+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, detection engineering, or closely related work. 
 You understand how analysts triage and investigate alerts and how detection quality affects their decisions and workload. 
 You know how to create and tune detections based on attacker behavior, available telemetry, and an expected investigation path. 
 You are experienced with security platforms such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or comparable monitoring and response technologies. 
 You can write code or use an automation platform to analyze security telemetry, enrich alerts, build investigation workflows, and remove repetitive work. Experience with Python or a similar language is valuable. 
 You understand modern detection-as-code practices, including GitHub, peer review, CI/CD, testing, and safely managing production detection content. 
 You have experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure. 
 You understand common threats affecting SaaS-oriented corporate and production environments. 
 You care about clear documentation, inclusive collaboration, and explaining security concepts to people with different backgrounds and levels of expertise.

title: Senior Applied Research Scientist - Personalization
content:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
Within Personalization, the Speak Team owns the development of Spotify's state-of-the-art speech models, contributing to speech recognition, speech synthesis, and speech-to-speech models. We craft voice models that match human-level emotional expressiveness, so we can deeply engage our listeners and support creators at scale. Our groundbreaking work on speech synthesis relies on state-of-the-art deep learning methods and evaluation techniques, highly efficient data processing and model serving, and capturing audio of outstanding quality from our voice talent pool.
We're looking for a senior applied research scientist with experience in developing novel ML techniques and architectures and with a strong interest in working across a full production pipeline to produce state-of-the-art generative conversational speech-to-speech models. You'll collaborate with our engineering teams to help develop our production pipelines, explore new ideas and methods to improve quality, understanding and realism, as well as push the frontiers of what is possible with our speech technology.
What You'll Do
Develop and experiment with new methods for speech synthesis and speech recognition, along with end-to-end approaches, building on the latest research and ideas.
 Work towards the expansion of our speech use-cases targeting different markets and products.
 Be part of a highly motivated research team dedicated to building and creating models at scale to power the Spotify platform.
 Champion best practices for research and development, sharing your knowledge and experience with other researchers within Speak.
 Collaborate with our engineering and data teams on ideas requiring new infrastructure or new high-quality data, as well as to help improve our speech recognition and speech synthesis pipelines, and help turn proven ideas into scalable products.
Who You Are
You have a strong background in ML (PhD degree on top of professional experience), and experience in working with any of the following: transformers, GANs, diffusion models, flow matching, VAEs, audio codecs.
 You have experience in developing generative models for speech synthesis, speech recognition, audio/music, natural language processing, or computer vision.
 You have strong experience with Python, particularly PyTorch.
 You have strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical ideas with clarity to technical and non-technical people alike.
 You have experience in an academic or professional setting conducting high-quality research.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in New York City.
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
content:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time.
What You'll Do
Build and run the backend services and data pipelines that ingest, validate and process music deliveries from partners, covering audio, metadata, lyrics and new content types
 Own large parts of the ingestion pipeline and lead technical work as we add video, richer partner data and other new content
 Make ingestion more reliable, catch data quality problems at the point of entry, and improve the operational tooling around the pipeline
 Design and evolve APIs and schemas that other teams depend on, keeping contracts stable and backward compatible
 Help move validation towards real time and make Silk Road a well-documented, self-serve platform
 Deliver roadmap work, take part in planning, review code, and share on-call
 Work with Content Ops, operations tooling teams, partner teams and the product teams that build on our content
Who You Are
You have strong experience building and operating backend services and data pipelines in production at scale, ideally in Java, Scala or Go
 You have designed APIs and handled schema evolution and backward compatibility in systems where other teams rely on stable contracts
 You’re comfortable modelling data for auditability, versioning and efficient querying and understand the tradeoffs between real-time and batch processing
 You lead projects from discovery to handover, make sound technical decisions, and mentor others
 You may have worked with content ingestion, metadata standards such as DDEX, B2B partner integrations, rights or compliance-sensitive data, lyrics or time-synced data, or GCP.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London or Stockholm.
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
content:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/
What You'll Do
Lead foundational measurement and insights work for generative music experiences, developing the frameworks that help Spotify understand how creators, listeners, and rights holders engage with generative AI music.
 Design and run large-scale analyses and evaluations of generative music systems, from prompt interpretation to model output quality, using Spotify's unique behavioral datasets, annotations, and experimentation platforms.
 Partner with Engineers and AI Researchers to integrate evaluation signals into model development loops, debugging workflows, and product iteration, making sure scientific rigor informs technical direction.
 Identify the behavioral and market dynamics that shape sustainable consumer demand and creator participation, and translate them into clear strategic recommendations.
 Build practical, scalable metrics and decision systems that define what "good" looks like for AI music: credibility, user delight, safety, creator alignment, and ecosystem trust.
 Bring together model, user behavior, and ecosystem signals into clear narratives that shape product strategy, cross-functional alignment, and long-term priorities across Spotify.
 Create the datasets, dashboards, and long-term measurement systems that give Spotify a lasting, comprehensive understanding of product health and impact.
 Work closely with Product, Design, Research, Legal, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Policy, and Licensing teams, bringing statistical rigor and principled measurement to help build artist-first systems that scale responsibly.
Who You Are 
You have a track record of using insights to shape strategy for major company initiatives involving many different partners.
 You have significant hands-on experience in advanced analytics or data science, ideally in a domain involving LLM evaluation, user-generated content, or complex user behavior.
 You communicate clearly, form well-founded, evidence-backed points of view, and can bring together messy, multimodal signals (quantitative, qualitative, and model telemetry) into clear narratives for senior executives, researchers, engineers, and the music industry.
 You're proficient in advanced analytics with Python and SQL, have analyzed large datasets, and use AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Copilot) to increase your productivity and impact.
 You have experience developing metrics frameworks for complex products that help teams measure impact and reason clearly about priorities.
 You have experience with machine learning frameworks, designing and assessing multimodal or embedding-based models, and validating them against LLM judges or human ground truth, with an understanding of how to evaluate models beyond offline accuracy.
 You have a solid grounding in experimental design and causal inference, such as A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and power analysis.
 You thrive when tackling loosely defined problems in ambiguous, zero-to-one spaces.
Where You'll Be 
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home
 This team operates within the US Eastern timezone for collaboration

title: Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer, Learning & Inclusion
content:
We’re looking for a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Inclusion team, the group responsible for creating learning experiences that help every Spotify band member grow, belong, and do their best work.
You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale. You’ll partner with subject-matter experts, people leaders, and Learning & Inclusion colleagues on company-wide initiatives, from leadership development to programs that bring Spotify’s values to life.
What You'll Do
Lead the end-to-end design of learning experiences, from needs analysis and curriculum architecture through development, launch, and evaluation.
 Partner with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to identify performance needs and turn them into clear learning objectives and practical solutions.
 Design learning journeys across live, digital, blended, and self-directed formats using evidence-based learning principles.
 Create engaging learning materials, including eLearning, facilitator guides, participant resources, job aids, presentations, and micro-learning experiences.
 Use visual design and storytelling to make complex ideas clear, memorable, and engaging while creating experiences that feel unmistakably Spotify.
 Build interactive digital learning experiences using AI-assisted workflows and authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar platforms.
 Design inclusive learning experiences that reflect different perspectives, reduce barriers to participation, and support a culture of belonging.
 Pilot and iterate on learning experiences using learner feedback, stakeholder input, and performance data.
 Define meaningful measures of success and evaluate learning effectiveness, knowledge transfer, learner experience, and behavior change.
 Manage multiple learning projects from initial scoping through delivery while creating clarity around priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
 Explore emerging approaches in learning design, including AI-assisted authoring and adaptive learning, and apply them where they can meaningfully improve the learner experience.
Who You Are
You have 5+ years of professional instructional design experience and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful work across multiple learning formats.
 You apply learning science principles such as cognitive load, retrieval practice, spaced learning, and adult learning theory to practical design decisions.
 You know how to uncover learning and performance needs, translate them into measurable objectives, and design learning journeys that build knowledge and skills over time.
 You create meaningful practice through scenarios, simulations, assessments, and other interactive experiences rather than relying on passive content.
 You have strong visual and UX design judgment and understand how typography, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling can make learning clearer and easier to navigate.
 You have experience with rapid authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Captivate, Lectora, or similar platforms, along with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent.
 You can create clear storyboards, scripts, facilitator guides, and supporting materials that help others confidently deliver consistent learning experiences.
 You use learner feedback and data to evaluate effectiveness, iterate on your work, and connect learning experiences to meaningful outcomes.
 You communicate complex ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with subject-matter experts, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
 You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and taking ownership from an early idea through a polished learning experience.
 You bring experience in areas such as inclusive learning design, leadership development, learning technology, short-form learning video or animation, LMS/LXP platforms, or SCORM/xAPI.
 You have a degree in instructional design, learning sciences, education, human-computer interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London or Stockholm
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

title: Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing
content:
Spotify is shaping the future of advertising by connecting brands with fans through audio, video, and experiences that are part of people's everyday lives. As our advertising business grows, we're focused on bringing innovative products to market, helping advertisers succeed, and turning new ideas into meaningful business growth.
We're looking for a Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing to lead the next chapter of our global Advertising Product Marketing team. Reporting to the Head of Advertising Business Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to shape product strategy, strengthen our market position, and help advertisers get more value from Spotify.
This is an opportunity to build and lead a product marketing function with a clear voice in product decisions and a direct impact on business growth. You'll bring customer insights into product development, establish a disciplined approach to go-to-market execution and product adoption, create compelling reasons for advertisers to choose Spotify, and help a global team deliver measurable results.
What You'll Do
Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for global Advertising Product Marketing, connecting advertiser needs, product innovation, competitive insights, and business growth.
 Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to bring customer and market insights into product decisions and turn innovation into solutions advertisers value.
 Lead global go-to-market strategies for Spotify's advertising products, including brand and performance advertising, self-service, programmatic, and emerging solutions. Own product positioning, messaging, packaging, launches, and adoption.
 Build a deeper understanding of advertisers, agencies, buying behaviors, and the competitive landscape. Use these insights to identify opportunities, influence product priorities, and strengthen Spotify's position in the market.
 Drive product adoption and commercial growth by identifying customer needs, addressing barriers to adoption, and partnering with teams to improve product usage, retention, and revenue. Define clear measures of success and use results to guide future decisions.
 Turn complex advertising technology, data, and measurement capabilities into clear, differentiated customer value propositions tied to measurable business outcomes. Partner with Business Marketing to create a consistent story across products and help advertisers understand the impact Spotify can deliver.
 Strengthen how products move from development to market. Establish clear processes, shared accountability, and measures of readiness that help teams make informed decisions about when to launch, scale, improve, or stop initiatives.
 Equip Sales and regional teams with the insights, messaging, and tools they need to bring Spotify's advertising solutions to customers. 
 Work with Measurement and Advertising Effectiveness teams to connect product capabilities with credible evidence of advertiser outcomes, and feed that evidence back into product decisions
 Explore how AI, automation, and emerging advertising technologies can improve our products, customer experiences, and product marketing practices and identify opportunities to rethink how Spotify develops, positions, and scales its advertising solutions.
 Lead and develop a high-performing global Product Marketing organization, attracting outstanding talent, strengthening strategic and commercial capabilities, and creating a culture of creativity, accountability, collaboration, and measurable impact.
Who You Are
You have 15+ years of experience
 You have built, scaled or transformed Product Marketing organizations in advertising technology, digital advertising or a related platform business. 
 You have led global teams across complex product portfolios, shaped product strategy and delivered business results.
 You understand how advertising businesses grow, including advertiser and agency needs, programmatic buying, self-service platforms, brand and performance advertising, and measurement.
 You have experience shaping product strategy and leading go-to-market initiatives across complex product portfolios, translating customer insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
 You are an influential executive communicator who engages credibly with senior Product, Engineering, and Commercial leaders, as well as externally with clients and partners.
 You combine strategic thinking with strong commercial judgment. You're comfortable using customer research, competitive insights, and performance data to make decisions, identify opportunities, and measure success.
 You can explain complex technology in clear, engaging ways and communicate effectively with senior leaders, advertisers, agencies, and business partners.
 You bring a forward-looking, hands-on view of AI, automation and emerging ad technologies. You don’t wait for change to arrive. You act on it early, spotting where these technologies can reshape our advertising products and inspire new ones, and you use AI to change how Product Marketing gets done.
 You have experience developing leaders and building inclusive, collaborative teams. You create clarity, encourage different perspectives, support growth, and balance long-term strategy with effective execution.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in New York.
 We ask that you come into the office 2–3 times per week.
The United States base range for this position is $291,071 - $414,388, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Information Technology
content:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
The IT Studio exists to remove the friction of work, unblocking Spotifiers anywhere, anytime, with simplicity and safety. We are the team behind the technology that approximately 8,000 Spotifiers rely on every day, spanning endpoint and device management, identity and access, networking and connectivity, IT service management and support, audio visual and meeting room technology, productivity and collaboration platforms, work management tooling, and the AI tools changing how everyone at Spotify works. Across 9 teams, we touch almost every part of how Spotify functions as a company.
We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to lead a group of Engineering Managers and approximately 50 engineers and technicians across the studio. You’ll set engineering strategy, strengthen the technical practices that help our teams operate at their best, and partner closely with product and studio leadership to balance engineering investment with business priorities.
What You'll Do
Lead and develop Engineering Managers across multiple teams, supporting their growth while creating clarity around outcomes and engineering excellence.
 Set and communicate engineering strategy across the studio, ensuring teams have clear technical direction aligned with IT’s mandate and Spotify’s business needs.
 Strengthen technical judgment across the Engineering Manager group, challenging processes that no longer add value and creating more space for architecture, quality, and team capability.
 Identify patterns and opportunities across teams and drive improvements in engineering practice, operational health, reliability, and ways of working.
 Establish and evolve engineering best practices across the studio, helping teams share knowledge and consistently improve how we build and operate technology.
 Champion reliability, security, compliance, and privacy as fundamental parts of engineering decision-making.
 Shape how AI is used across the company, both through the tools our squads build and how our engineers work day to day.
 Partner with studio and alliance leadership, procurement, legal, engineering counterparts, and teams across Spotify to make thoughtful technical investments and solve meaningful business problems.
Who You Are
You have 8+ years of engineering experience and experience leading Engineering Managers across multiple teams.
 You have led engineering organisations at scale and can demonstrate how the technical strategies you’ve shaped have influenced meaningful outcomes.
 You bring experience with enterprise technology such as identity and access, SaaS platforms, endpoint management, workplace technology, architecture, or related systems, and can engage credibly in technical decisions across these areas.
 You have improved engineering practices across multiple teams and know how to balance developer productivity, operational excellence, reliability, and sustainable technical investment.
 You have developed Engineering Managers into stronger leaders and can point to meaningful growth and progression within the teams you’ve led.
 You’re excited about how AI is changing the way people and engineering organisations work and have practical experience applying AI tooling or related technologies.
 You focus performance conversations on impact rather than activity and can assess contributions across teams producing different kinds of outcomes.
 You’re a strategic thinker who can set direction across a broad organisation while staying close enough to the work to contribute when needed.
 You communicate complex technical and strategic ideas clearly, build inclusion into how you lead, and can make thoughtful decisions when working through ambiguity.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London or Stockholm.
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Messaging Platform
content:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.
The Messaging Platform powers Spotify’s communications to over a billion users — from push notifications to emails and in-app messages that connect listeners to the content they love. Within this space, the Paloma squad focuses on message optimization: deciding which message reaches which user, through which channel, and at what moment.
We’re evolving how messaging works at Spotify — moving from short-term optimization toward systems that understand long-term user journeys. By combining reinforcement learning approaches with deeper domain signals, we’re expanding how machine learning shapes the entire messaging funnel.
What You'll Do
Design, build, and ship machine learning models that optimize messaging across push, email, and in-app channels
 Plan and run A/B experiments in a multi-objective environment, balancing conversion, engagement, retention, and reachability
 Contribute to reinforcement learning systems that optimize for long-term user outcomes rather than immediate interactions
 Partner with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to define what success looks like and how to measure it
 Own the full ML lifecycle, from data and modeling to deployment, monitoring, and iteration
 Integrate ML models with upstream systems, including domain value signals and opportunity generation frameworks
 Help shape the future of AI-assisted development within the team, exploring how tools can accelerate experimentation and delivery
Who You Are
You have strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production environments at scale
 You are comfortable translating business problems into ML solutions and discussing trade-offs with cross-functional partners
 You have worked on complex optimization problems such as ranking systems or multi-objective decision-making
 You bring hands-on experience with PyTorch and distributed systems such as Ray or similar frameworks
 You understand experimentation deeply and can design reliable tests in environments with interacting metrics
 You are able to analyze results using approaches like causal inference or metric decomposition when needed
 You have experience with or curiosity about reinforcement learning and long-term optimization systems
 You enjoy working across disciplines and navigating ambiguity while shaping strategy and direction
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London and Stockholm

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineering Manager - Content Platform
content:
We design Spotify's consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
You'll lead a senior-heavy group of 10–12 machine learning engineers, including Staff engineers, who team up dynamically to solve high-priority business problems while staying deep in content understanding (audio, video and text). This is a player-coach role with a strong strategic remit: you'll shape where the group goes next, grow our audio understanding expertise over the long term, and help the team scale through thoughtful, practical use of AI in everyday engineering work.
What You'll Do
Lead, coach and grow a group of 10+ senior and Staff machine learning engineers who team up dynamically around business problems while staying deep in their domain.
 Set technical and team strategy for multiple content understanding problems and turn it into clear, achievable plans.
 Own delivery of high-priority company initiatives, from shaping the problem through to measurable impact for listeners.
 Stay close to the technology as a player-coach. Lead technical strategy, reviewing designs, guiding modelling and retrieval choices, and contributing hands-on where it helps the team most.
 Define and champion a practical point of view on how ML engineers use AI tools in their day-to-day work, and help the team realise real productivity gains.
 Partner with product, design, research and other engineering leaders across Spotify to align priorities and share context.
Who You Are
You have deep machine learning expertise and Staff-level technical judgement, and you're comfortable getting hands-on when it matters.
 You bring experience across NLP, audio / music content understanding and recommender systems.
 You have a track record of managing engineering teams while delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives.
 You enjoy coaching senior and Staff engineers, and you help experienced people grow their impact.
 You have a clear, informed point of view on using AI to improve how ML engineers work, and you can inspire a team to adopt it.
 You think strategically, communicate clearly, and can balance long-term bets with near-term delivery.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London or Stockholm.
 We offer the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meeetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

title: Senior Music Editor, Indonesia
content:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Editor for Indonesia, to join Spotify’s Music Editorial team based in Jakarta. In this role you will be part of the Music team in Southeast Asia, reporting to the regional Head of Editorial.
You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, including playlist curation, creative editorial work, and cross-functional collaboration with different teams in the region and beyond. You will provide deep cultural and musical insights to create highly engaging and cohesive music experiences for listeners, extending beyond playlists, while ensuring an unbiased editorial voice for a wide array of moods, moments, and genres. Additionally, you will drive artist discovery through an extensive editorial ecosystem of playlists and tools, critically assessing music trends and user behavior to identify opportunities and emerging trends.
You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally. Additionally, you will have an editorial personality that thrives in engaging audiences through creative formats, bringing the playlists to life in innovative ways.
You will be encouraged to make data-informed decisions while also contributing creative and cultural expertise. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape!
What You'll Do
Develop and execute a holistic editorial strategy for Indonesia that aligns with regional business goals
 Shape and evolve our editorial voice across playlists, written and visual storytelling, and short-form content on and off platform
 Pioneer creative and innovative formats to bring playlists to life and deepen connection with listeners
 Proactively identify music trends, emerging talent, and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, acting as a cultural guide
 Curate cohesive, engaging playlists for Indonesia with compelling descriptions and commentary that resonate with audiences
 Lead editorial representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets at both a regional and global level with teams like artist & label partnerships, marketing, design, PR, and product
 Maintain and refine a strong playlist ecosystem that supports artist discovery and deepens artist-fan engagement
 Analyze user behavior and performance data to optimize playlist engagement and make informed editorial decisions, translating high-level insights into actionable initiatives
 Collaborate with global and regional editorial teams on programming initiatives and strategies to enhance Spotify’s market position.
Who You Are
At least 8+ years of experience in the music industry, journalism, programming/curating music for digital, radio, TV, or other media outlets
 You have deep knowledge of music and culture, possessing broad expertise across all genres and styles, from Indo Pop to HipDut, Indie to Javanese music, with the ability to curate music for diverse moods and moments
 Skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support editorial decisions and build clear narratives
 You have a strong editorial voice and are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements, and audience behavior beyond just data
 A confident storyteller and public speaker, fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia to effectively advocate for the market and secure stakeholder buy-in
 An excellent communicator, capable of connecting with audiences through written, video, or audio commentary to enhance playlists
 You’re a team player who is detail-oriented and consistently demonstrates a positive attitude, adaptable and at ease navigating fast-changing priorities in a dynamic environment, comfortable navigating complex global-to-local organizational structures and aligning cross-functional teams around Editorial priorities
 You are curious about how technology and culture intersect, constantly exploring new, innovative formats to keep Spotify at the forefront of the cultural zeitgeist
 You are comfortable on-camera and experienced crafting social-first content and working with video production teams
 You are knowledgeable of Google Suite tools, comfortable with basic design tools and workflows, capable of creating visual assets like playlist covers when necessary.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in Jakarta
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

title: Senior Product Manager - Spotify Connect
content:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays.
You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.
What You'll Do
Own the product strategy and roadmap for your scope within Spotify Connect, turning the broader Seamless direction into clear priorities.
 Work with research and data colleagues to understand cross-device behavior, identify friction, and define measures of success.
 Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive and reliable experiences for discovering devices, controlling playback, and moving between them.
 Balance improvements to everyday usability and reliability with experiments that uncover new value.
 Work across teams and partner-facing functions to manage dependencies and deliver a coherent end-to-end experience.
 Explore opportunities created by richer device understanding and emerging ways of interacting with Spotify, keeping privacy, permissions, and user control central.
 Clearly communicate product choices, progress, and results, and use what you learn to improve the roadmap.
Who You Are
You have experience owning and delivering high-quality consumer products, from identifying a problem through launch and iteration.

title: Senior Product Quality Analyst - AI Voice
content:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.
As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?
What You'll Do
Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases.
 Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience.
 Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams.
 Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve.
 Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve.
 Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market.
 Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities.
 Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities.
Who You Are
You have experience in product quality, evaluation, data curation or a closely related field where human judgment is used to assess model or product performance.
 You know how to independently define evaluation criteria and turn subjective qualities into clear, repeatable rubrics.
 You are comfortable designing and running both qualitative and MOS-style evaluations and synthesizing the results into actionable insights.
 You have an understanding of voice or audio quality, including qualities such as naturalness, pacing, tone, accent and pronunciation, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly.
 You have strong judgment and can maintain a consistent quality bar while balancing different product requirements, markets and stakeholder perspectives.
 You are comfortable working autonomously, identifying what needs to be evaluated and establishing the processes and cadence to make that evaluation useful over time.
 You communicate clearly across creative, technical and product teams and can act as a reliable point of contact for internal partners and external vendors.
 You are curious about generative AI, speech technology and the evolving AI voice landscape and can translate changes in the industry into meaningful benchmarks for Spotify.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London
